roles.title: Software Engineer, C++
roles.eligibility: "5 - 7 years of deep expertise in C++". No graduation-year or student gate, but the experience bar is well above the candidate's ~18 months.
roles.requirements: 5-7 years deep C++ expertise | Python proficiency for scripting/tooling | Background in low-latency or high-throughput environments | Strong algorithms and data structures | Clean, maintainable code | Second-line support for own systems, first-line during deployments
roles.notes: Designs and builds trading system components. Application form asks 'Do you require any VISA Sponsorship?' with no stated policy; Singapore EP sponsorship needed for this candidate. Main mismatch is the 5-7 year bar - this is a mid/senior req, not the new-grad pipeline the existing sheet row assumed.

roles.title: Quantitative Researcher
roles.eligibility: "2-5 years of programming experience in Python (pandas, numpy, scipy)" or equivalent statistical/ML background. No student or graduation-year gate.
roles.requirements: 2-5 years Python (pandas/numpy/scipy) or equivalent stats/ML background | Predictive statistics, ML, econometrics or time-series analysis | Solid data structures, algorithms and software fundamentals | Bilingual English and Mandarin (spoken and written) | Linux and networking knowledge (preferred) | Reproducible research practices (preferred)
roles.notes: HARD BLOCKER unless the candidate has Mandarin: the posting states bilingual English and Mandarin (spoken and written) competency as a requirement, even though the seat is Singapore-based (likely China/HK market coverage). Otherwise the closest fit on the board to the candidate's profile in terms of years of experience. Sponsorship question on the form, no stated policy.

roles.title: Trader
roles.eligibility: 3-5 years of relevant trading experience in HFT and/or professional equity trading, plus a proven P&L track record. Experienced-hire only - not a junior/graduate trader seat.
roles.requirements: 3-5 years HFT and/or professional equity trading experience | Proven P&L track record | Develop and execute intraday strategies (<24h holding period) | Strong risk management and regulatory compliance knowledge | Programming knowledge (Python preferred) advantageous | Decisive under pressure
roles.notes: Requires an existing trading P&L track record, which the candidate does not have. Listed for completeness of the Trader track; realistically not applicable. Sponsorship question on the form, no stated policy.

roles.title: Portfolio Manager
roles.eligibility: Requires "a strong track record of success, with a P&L of > USD 5mm/year" in HFT or portfolio management. Senior seat-lift/PM hire - out of reach for this candidate.
roles.requirements: HFT or portfolio management experience with >USD 5mm/year P&L | Strategy portable/transferable to Grasshopper | Index roll or index arbitrage experience may qualify | Coverage across Japan, Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, CME futures, Australia, Taiwan, India, HK, China or Korea | Deep knowledge of markets and trading technology | BSc/MSc in Finance, Economics, Maths, CS or related
roles.notes: Seat-lift / PM hire with a portable book. Included only to document the board; not a realistic target.

existing_rows_audit.detail: Grasshopper's own Greenhouse board has no 'Quantitative Developer' req; the equivalent C++ seat is titled 'Software Engineer, C++' (https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/grasshopperasia/jobs/4634158008). The row's eligibility claim is also wrong: the posting requires '5 - 7 years of deep expertise in C++', so this is a mid/senior req, NOT a new-grad or entry-level pipeline. The row's comp figure (SGD 160-240k) is not stated anywhere on the posting or the firm's site and should be treated as unverified. The Singapore office itself is confirmed (72 Anson Road #09-01, Anson House, Singapore 079911, https://grasshopperasia.com/contact/).

notes: Primary source is the firm's own Greenhouse board, https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/grasshopperasia, linked from https://grasshopperasia.com/careers/. The whole board was 6 reqs on 2026-08-04, ALL in Singapore: Network Engineer, Portfolio Manager, Quantitative Researcher, Quantitative Risk Analyst, Software Engineer C++, Trader. Two were excluded as out of scope: 'Network Engineer' (infrastructure/networking, not C++ development) and 'Senior Quantitative Risk Analyst' (6-8 years, risk-management function rather than alpha research, https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/grasshopperasia/jobs/4180546008). No ML Performance / GPU / kernel-engineering roles exist on the board at all. Offices: Singapore HQ confirmed on the contact page; the firm also announced a Ho Chi Minh City engineering office (https://grasshopperasia.com/grasshopper-announces-opening-of-new-ho-chi-minh-city-office/) which is out of scope for this pass. No evidence of Hong Kong, Shanghai, Tokyo, or any EU/UK office. Coverage gap: the careers page's own category links (grasshopperasia.com/job/trading, /technology, /middle-office) were not individually crawled, but they funnel to the same Greenhouse board. No compensation figures are stated on any posting; the firm's site and postings say only 'competitive', so all comp_local fields are left empty. Every posting includes a 'Do you require any VISA Sponsorship?' form field without a stated policy - Singapore Employment Pass sponsorship would be needed and is routine at this tier but is not confirmed by the firm.
